items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: I lived with him. Oh yeah? Yeah, him and his wife for a while I lived with him.

ctx.x: I don't know if Christmas meant much in 35 to a lot of people. There's no Santa Claus maybe.

Do you remember Bob Sylvester? Oh God, yeah. I lived with him. Oh yeah? Yeah, him and his wife for a while I lived with him. Where is he now? I don't know. I lost track of him entirely when I left New York. He probably stayed around New York a good while after I'd left there. Of course he might have been there when I went back in 39 but I didn't get to see him. Yeah, I lived with Bob and his wife. She was singing, she had a singing, a singing program on one of the stations there and Bob was struggling along…
Yeah, I think Pop Foster knew him well.
